channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: No último programa eleitoral de sua história, Lula pede um novo capítulo
item.description: Lula presents his final electoral program, deemed historic, with proposals for Brazil's future. At 80 years old, he states this is his last presidential run.

item.title: 'De virada é mais gostoso', dizem estudantes em ato pró-Lula na PUC
item.description: PUC and Uninove students held a pro-Lula rally outside the Tuca Theater in São Paulo with a 'turnaround' atmosphere following a Datafolh poll. The event emphasized support for the former president in the 2026 elections.

item.title: PT pede mandado contra Kássio por decisőes contra 'Exército de Lula'
item.description: The PT filed a writ of security at the TSE against decisions by Chief Justice Kassio Nunes Marques regarding the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', managed by federal deputy André Janones.

item.title: Datafolha torna debate da Globo tăo estratégico quanto arriscado
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied at 50% in valid votes, making the Globo debate a strategic platform to sway undecided voters. Lula's campaign appears to have gained momentum in the final stretch.

item.title: Casa desliza por barranco e fica inteira após chuvas no PR; veja o vídeo
item.description: A house in Imbituva (PR) slid down a hill after heavy rains but remained intact. The area was monitored by the city hall and evacuated preventively, with no injuries. Nine people from two families were displaced and receive social housing assistance.

item.title: Penúltima pesquisa Datafolha sobre disputa Flávio x Lula mostra um zero a zero, diz cientista político
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll projects a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, each with 50% of valid votes, according to political scientist Elias Tavares. The PT campaign has re-engaged in the runoff by targeting Flávio’s image and returning to street mobilization, though both candidates face record-high rejection rates (48%).

item.title: Live de Lula e Janones chega a 1,18 milhão de aparelhos simultâneos
item.description: A live stream featuring Lula and Janones reached over 1.18 million simultaneous viewers on YouTube, mobilizing the 'Lula Army' ahead of the 2026 election final stretch. The broadcast included influencers and celebrities, with Janones assigning missions to engage supporters on social media.

item.title: Cleitinho e Domingos Sávio participam de ato pró-Flávio em Divinópolis (MG)
item.description: The elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo, and the elected senator Domingos Sávio attended a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro rally in Divinópolis (MG), named 'Bloquinho 22'. Other politicians present included Bruno Engler, Eduardo Azevedo, and Gleidson Azevedo. Flávio Bolsonaro did not attend the event, instead appearing at a rally in Recife (PE).

item.title: Willer Tomaz diz que “sala secreta” é cofre de empresa de táxi aéreo
item.description: Willer Tomaz claimed that the 'secret room' found in a hangar at Brasília Airport is a safe room belonging to an air taxi company he is a partner in, used for storing valuables under contract with security firms. He questioned the timing of the report's release, suggesting it was intentionally published days before the runoff election to harm PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. Tomaz is under investigation in the 'Sem Desconto' operation for alleged fraud against INSS retirees and was the largest bettor in Brazil in 2025.

item.title: Flávio cancela participação em live por aniversário de Fernanda
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro canceled his weekly live stream to celebrate his wife Fernanda's birthday, three days before the second round of elections. The guest-hosted broadcast averaged about 10,000 simultaneous viewers, while Lula's stream exceeded 1 million.

item.title: TSE dá 12 horas para Meta explicar alcance de perfil de Nikolas Ferreira e fixa multa
item.description: The TSE gave Meta 12 hours to provide data on content distribution for the profiles of Nikolas Ferreira, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Pablo Marçal, imposing a fine of R$100,000 per hour of delay. The decision aims to analyze suspicions of abuse of power and misuse of communication means in a lawsuit filed by Lula's coalition.

item.title: Lula pede ao TSE retirada de canal de Janones do registro de sua candidatura e acusa Flávio de tentar tumultuar processo
item.description: Lula's defense team requested the TSE to remove the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', managed by André Janones, from the campaign registration and accused Flávio Bolsonaro of trying to disrupt the electoral process. The PT campaign claims the channel is independent and that its inclusion in the registration was merely to comply with a judicial order. The TSE has already approved a resolution to establish criteria for linking third-party channels to electoral campaigns.

item.title: TRE-MG determina transporte intermunicipal gratuito no 2º turno
item.description: The Minas Gerais Electoral Court (TRE-MG) issued a preliminary injunction requiring free intermunicipal public transport with weekday-level service during the second round of the 2026 elections, following a lawsuit by the Esperança Brasil Federation. The ruling aims to protect voting access in metropolitan areas such as Belo Horizonte and Vale do Aço, under penalties for non-compliance.

item.title: Como será o último programa eleitoral da carreira política de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign concluded his final electoral program of his political career, set to air on TV this Friday, two days before the runoff. At 80 years old, the president is running for his seventh election to the Planalto Palace, emerging as a central figure in the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: Flávio é rejeitado por 46% e Lula, por 45%, diz Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 46% of voters reject Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and 45% reject Lula (PT), followed by 3% who reject both and 6% who reject neither. The study was conducted between October 20-22, 2026, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: O que os números do Datafolha revelam além do empate
item.description: Datafolha poll shows tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in runoff at 50% valid votes each. Lula's growth linked to street movement and progressive support, while anti-PT sentiment (25%) exceeds anti-Bolsonaro sentiment (13%).

item.title: Zema e mesários serão ouvidos pela PC por uso de celular durante votação
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) will be questioned by police after being caught using a phone inside the voting booth during the 2026 election first round. The investigation was ordered by electoral justice, which will also interrogate the poll workers present. Using electronic devices in the booth is prohibited, and the incident is under scrutiny.

item.title: Vantagem de Flávio sobre Lula na faixa de renda acima de cinco salários mínimos tem forte queda, mostra Datafolha
item.description: Flávio's lead over Lula among voters earning above five minimum wages dropped from 25 to 14 percentage points, according to Datafolha. Lula rose from 34% to 40% of voting intentions in this segment, while Flávio fell from 59% to 54%. Measures such as the Bolsa Família adjustment and MEI benefits may have influenced this shift.

item.title: Vorcaro escolheu whisky de R$ 500 mil para presentear Lula
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, purchased a Macallan 1945 whisky worth R$500,000 to gift President Lula, according to messages obtained by the Federal Police. The gift occurred amid liquidity issues at Banco Master and several of Vorcaro's visits to the Planalto Palace in 2023 and 2024.

item.title: Congressistas dos EUA pedem à Meta explicações sobre eleição no Brasil
item.description: Thirteen U.S. lawmakers sent a letter to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg on October 22 requesting explanations about how the company's platforms treated the campaigns of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) during Brazil's 2022 election. The letter emphasizes the responsibility of Big Tech in ensuring transparency in democratic processes and asks for clarification on potential biases or censorship in political advertising on Meta's social media platforms.

item.title: Flávio tem 46% de rejeição contra 45% de Lula, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has 46% rejection among voters, compared to 45% rejection of President Lula (PT). The survey also reveals that 3% of respondents reject both candidates, while 6% do not reject either one, and Flávio moved two percentage points compared to the previous survey.

item.title: Lula fala em criar secretaria de finanças populares com Nath Finanças
item.description: Lula proposed the creation of a popular finance secretariat focused on low-income populations during a live broadcast with influencer Nath Finanças. He emphasized the importance of accessible financial education and praised her ability to explain economic issues simply. The initiative is part of potential public policies for a new administration, should he be reelected.

item.title: Governo avisa idosos que votar vale prova de vida às vésperas do 2º turno
item.description: Three days before the runoff, the federal government sent messages to seniors and pensioners reminding them that voting can serve as proof of life for INSS benefits. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a complaint with the TSE accusing misuse of public resources and abuse of power. Wilson Lima and Carlos Graieb discussed the issue on Papo Antagonista.

item.title: Lula diz que Meta vai ter que ser reinventada e que empresa não pode enganar a humanidade 'todo tempo'
item.description: Lula stated that Meta needs to be reinvented and cannot deceive humanity, during a livestream with André Janones. The PT campaign accuses the company of favoring Flávio Bolsonaro, though Meta denies any bias.

item.title: Lula usa ‘celular errado’ em live com Janones
item.description: President Lula used André Janones' phone during a live stream simultaneously broadcast on both of their YouTube channels. The incident sparked comments about the rapport and interaction between the two politicians during the live broadcast.

item.title: Datafolha: rejeição a Flávio é de 46% e a de Lula registra 45%
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on October 22 shows that rejection of senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) reached 46%, while 45% would not vote for President Lula (PT) in a second round. The variations are within the margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: O advogado que liga Flávio, bets, Lobão e a ilha de Angra
item.description: Footballer Richarlison accused Flávio Bolsonaro and lawyer Willer Tomaz of irregular possession of a mansion in Ilha Comprida. Lula announced a Federal Police investigation. The case involves political connections and corruption investigations.

item.title: Mendonça diz que não cabe à Justiça Eleitoral definir liberação de sigilo de candidatos
item.description: Minister André Mendonça stated that the decision to release banking, tax, and phone secrets of candidates Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is the responsibility of each candidate individually, and the Electoral Court should not interfere. He emphasized that data can be directly accessed by the account holders and stressed the need for judicial investigations to clarify possible irregularities, especially involving third-party accounts.

item.title: Caso Ana Clara: coletivos vão ao TSE protestar contra decisão de Mendonça
item.description: Civil society groups held a protest at the TSE against minister André Mendonça's decision to suspend campaign ads from Lula's (PT) team linking Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to the Ana Clara case, deemed as negative electoral content. The case revolves around a girl's death in 2021 during a police operation in Rio de Janeiro, later defended by Flávio on behalf of the accused officer.

item.title: A doação de R$ 500 mil de herdeiro do Beto Carrero World a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A $500,000 donation via Pix was made to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign in the name of Alexandre von Janke Murad, heir to the family that owns Beto Carrero World. The donation drew attention due to its amount and connection to an influential entertainment businessman.

item.title: Relatora da ONU critica censura de canais de WhatsApp na eleição brasileira
item.description: UN Special Rapporteur for freedom of association and assembly, Gina Romero, criticized the censorship of WhatsApp channels during the Brazilian election, warning about risks to freedom of expression. The statement highlights international concerns regarding restrictions on digital communication in electoral processes.

item.title: Políticos da França assinam texto e falam em risco com extrema direita e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Over 40 French politicians signed a Le Monde op-ed warning about far-right risks in Brazil if Flávio Bolsonaro wins Sunday's election. The article reflects international concern over a potential authoritarian scenario. Brazil holds its election on Sunday.

item.title: Lula diz que Exército do Lula superará os de EUA, China e Rússia
item.description: President Lula stated during a live broadcast on WhatsApp that the 'Lula Army' will surpass the armies of China, Russia, and the United States, framing his movement as opposed to the 'army of evil' and rallying supporters ahead of the final stretch of the 2026 presidential election against Flavio Bolsonaro.

item.title: PGR defende que STF rejeite pedido de acesso a dados de visitas de esposa de Moraes e Vorcaro ao Senado
item.description: The PGR argued that the STF should reject a request to access Senate visitor logs involving figures such as Justice Minister Moraes' wife and former banker Vorcaro, citing procedural grounds and parliamentary secrecy. The Senate also opposed disclosure, invoking parliamentary and journalistic source secrecy. The case will be reviewed by rapporteur Justice Luiz Fux.

item.title: Mendonça diz que não cabe ao TSE divulgar sigilos de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE ruled that it is not up to Electoral Justice to disclose the secrets of President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that the candidates may take this initiative on their own. The decision was made on Thursday, May 22.

item.title: Governo Lula gasta R$ 238 mi para disparar WhatsApp a usuários de benefícios sociais
item.description: The federal government spent BRL 237.76 million with the private company Microtarget Marketing and Publicity to send WhatsApp messages to beneficiaries of social programs such as Bolsa Família and Luz do Povo. The contract, managed by the Iaupe Institute and linked to the Ministry of Social Development, also includes customer service, data analysis and artificial intelligence, as defended by the ministry. The opposition questions transparency and the use of public resources in private companies.

item.title: Alckmin diz que candidatos à Presidência não deveriam ter sigilo
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that presidential candidates should not have any banking, fiscal, or telephone confidentiality, criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro's demands for document disclosure. He emphasized that the public should know who is corrupt in the country, reaffirming support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at an event in São Paulo.

item.title: Datafolha: colunistas do GLOBO analisam os números de Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula na nova pesquisa
item.description: A new Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 47% of voting intentions, against Lula (PT) at 46%, narrowing the gap between the candidates. Globo columnists analyze the numbers and highlight key cities that could decide the second round. The content also discusses differences in rhetoric and campaign strategies between the two candidates.

item.title: Nunes Marques dá 24h para Meta detalhar atuação do 'Exército do Lula'; as últimas notícias antes do 2º turno
item.description: A new Datafolha poll released one hour before the second round shows a statistical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), both with 50% of valid votes. The survey, conducted between October 20 and 22, interviewed 2,520 people and has a margin of error of plus or minus two points. In total votes, including whites, nulls, and undecideds, Flávio leads with 47%, followed by Lula with 46%.

item.title: Pesquisa segundo turno, Lula e Flávio: o que dizem os levantamentos para presidente
item.description: Recent polls for the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) indicate a tight race, with Bolsonaro generally ahead but within the margin of error. Leading institutes (PoderData/Aya, Quaest and Meio/Ideia) show minimal swings in the lead, underscoring the competitiveness of the election.

item.title: Manifesto: A 3 dias das urnas, Kassio dobra aposta na intervenção das redes
item.description: The TSE presidency authorized direct intervention in the official social media accounts of campaigns, allowing parties and candidates to manipulate content on digital platforms. The decision, made 72 hours before the elections, intensifies ideological control over political communication and increases the risk of structured disinformation.

item.title: 'Bolsonaro Talvane Albuquerque': por que Janones incentivou busca no Google
item.description: André Janones (Rede-MG) encourages Lula supporters to search 'Bolsonaro Talvane Albuquerque' on Google, aiming to recover a speech by Jair Bolsonaro defending Talvane Albuquerque, later convicted of ordering the murder of federal deputy Marielle Franco. The strategy seeks to associate past figures with corruption and violence cases amid a polarized political landscape. Janones criticizes linking Lula to corruption schemes while highlighting the violent history of Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: Nova pesquisa para presidente hoje: o que dizem os levantamentos dessa quinta (22)
item.description: Polls released on Thursday (22) show Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in projections for the 2026 second round, though margins of error keep the race within a technical tie. Institutes PoderData/Aya, Quaest, Meio/Ideia, Palver, and RealTime Big Data recorded variations between 45% and 52% for Bolsonaro and 44% to 50% for Lula, depending on vote counting criteria (valid or total votes).

item.title: TSE dá 24h para Meta detalhar canal “Exército do Lula”
item.description: The TSE ordered Meta to submit a detailed technical report on the 'Exército do Lula' channel within 24 hours, following a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) to verify compliance plans and detect potential coordination irregularities or artificial content amplification. The ruling also requires explanation of criteria distinguishing legitimate mobilization from coordinated behavior and analysis of activities from October 18-20, 2026.

item.title: Crusoé: Deltan acusa PT de “estelionato eleitoral”
item.description: Senator-elect Deltan Dallagnol (Novo-PR) accused the PT of committing an “electoral scam,” claiming the party used images of documents that would not be confidential from President Lula. He said he was alerted by Senator-elect Gustavo Gayer about the release of these photos. The accusation was published in a video on Thursday morning.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula e Janones promovem live
item.description: Lula and Janones hold a live stream to mobilize supporters in the final stretch of the presidential runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Pacote de bondades não teve viés eleitoral, diz Durigan
item.description: Minister of Finance Dario Durigan stated that President Lula's benefit package has no electoral bias and improved public accounts by 200 billion reais compared to the Bolsonaro administration. He emphasized fiscal discipline and the 16 billion reais budget blockage in 2026 as evidence of expense control.

item.title: Neymar aproveita postagem de MC Cabelinho para declarar voto em Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Dito isso, 22'
item.description: Neymar Jr. expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro by commenting on a post by MC Cabelinho on Instagram ahead of the election runoff. The video, produced by the Revelando Brasil project, questions Flávio's political trajectory but was removed by Instagram over alleged AI use. The player's comment received over 185,000 likes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro x Lula: veja quem Augusto Cury, Renan Santos e outros candidatos a presidente derrotados no 1º turno apoiam
item.description: Five former candidates endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, including Romeu Zema and Ronaldo Caiado, while three backed Lula, such as Edmilson Costa. Others remained neutral or critical, reflecting polarization among first-round losers.

item.title: A cautela na campanha de Lula com a 'virada' dos trackings
item.description: Piauí Governor Rafael Fonteles celebrated tracking polls showing Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round. The article highlights Lula's cautious approach in a crucial election moment. Content is exclusive to subscribers.
